Memetic Carrier Frame.description: A whole memetic-wikitext carrier: the doctype declaration, the four frame markers, the toml meta block, one ahu section and the content-hash line lares meme normalize mints

Memetic Doctype Declaration.description: The declaration line that names a file's dialect and its lar: address, which the finder reads in place of the path

Memetic Carrier Marker.description: One carrier frame marker, carrying the control code that names which of the four frame positions it holds

Memetic Meta Block.description: The toml meta block a carrier head carries: its title, its type and the uri-path the address derives from

Memetic Ahu Section.description: An ahu section, opened on its fragment and closed on the matching sigil so the body stands inside a named block

Memetic Kanawai.description: The kanawai firing, naming the reference a carrier holds its own terms against

Memetic Set Aim.description: The set firing that opens a turn: lares=`aim` leads, from= reads operator intent and to= names the bearing the node adopts, and the ward rides last as the frame orders it
Memetic Set Aim.body: <<~ set lares=`aim` from=`lar://${1:alias}:operator@${2:crossroads}/${3:operator.intent.lands}` to=`lar://${4:alias}:agent@${2:crossroads}/${5:council.options.cuts}` mode=`${6|draft,build,seal,riff,sketch,jam,relate,talk-story,hold|}` aperture=`${7:10}/${8|pulse,beat,measure,arc,theme|}` ooda-ha=`${9:5}/${10|declare-aftermath,declare-glyphs,declare-attention,declare-intent,declare-consequence|}` drift-ward=`${11:the pull this exchange carries}`>>

Memetic Set Steer.description: The set firing that turns a turn mid-way: lares=`steer` leads, a new to= when the heading turns, any other key on the same heading, and the ward last
Memetic Set Steer.body: <<~ set lares=`steer` to=`lar://${1:alias}:agent@${2:crossroads}/${3:clerk.marks.the-gap}` mode=`${4|draft,build,seal,riff,sketch,jam,relate,talk-story,hold|}` drift-ward=`${5:the pull this heading carries}`>>

Memetic Set Yield.description: The set firing that closes a turn: lares=`yield` leads, the ward comes first, each gauge slides from target to actual, and from= and to=`?` hand initiative back last
Memetic Set Yield.body: <<~ set lares=`yield` drift-ward=`${1:the joint that breaks first on outside contact} · ↻ L-Prime` aperture=`${2:10}/${3:measure} -> ${4:12}/${5:measure}` ooda-ha=`closed ${6:1}↺` from=`lar://${7:alias}:agent@${8:crossroads}/${9:close.named.the-reading}` to=`?`>>

Memetic Oracle.description: The oracle firing, carrying the felt-spend, the scatter, the die face and a blind tail whose length matches the face

Memetic Stance.description: The stance firing, naming the standpoints the following content reads within

Memetic Mu Tool Carry.description: The mu firing, naming which of the five tools of Chapel Perilous the following span carries

Memetic Node.description: The node firing, naming the act the node performs as a verb phrase
Memetic Node.body: <<~ node action=`${1:refreshes the libation dish, the shrine incense burns}`>>
